_note: v3.0 harvest defect check 2026-10-30 item 3 (SUMMARY.md §Defect check, M05), row HF-FOLD, Chat Completion lane. Two sealed chapters with fold on must leave ONE leading folded block in ST's real CC prompt assembly (setOpenAIMessages, openai.js:578-647), with no ignored interior row between kept rows and the tail kept (unit twin: src/runtime/chapterFoldHole.review.test.ts). Story: three chapters, keep_tail 2 on the two that seal; 8 marked rows ([hf-r<index>]) in each, 4 in the third; each seal is the transition boundary's own seal (/cp set step N) with a mocked seal answer (storyOrchestratorDebugChapterSealResponse), so the records are deterministic. Before the fix the fold was two ranges (0-5, 8-13) and rows 6-7 (chapter 1's tail) were a hole; now it is one block 0-13 and rows 14-19 are kept. Capture: one real (non-dry) ST Generate for Arin (/trigger await=true), so the generate interceptor and the fold run (a dry run skips interceptors, script.js:4562); talkControlInterceptor is wrapped for that one call only (restored in finally and in cleanup) to read the IGNORE flags on the chat it was handed, and GENERATE_AFTER_DATA gives the CC messages ST built. The CC transport (**/api/backends/chat-completions/generate) is blocked for that call, so NO model call is made: the owner's Terra route has no OpenAI-compatible endpoint (the harness plugin serves only /status, /complete, /cancel, /agent/*), and the hole is decided before the request leaves. Asserts: the folded rows are exactly a leading run equal to [record 1 from .. record 2 to - keep_tail], no IGNORE flag after the first kept row, every CC message has string content, every kept marker is in the CC prompt once and in chat order, no folded marker reaches it. Lane needs: main API Chat Completion (requires.mainApi openai) with a status check that passes (Generate refuses with no_connection), e.g. a CC profile source custom at http://127.0.0.1:18888/v1 on the local Artemis server with custom_include_body chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking: false}; lane 41 has only Text Completion profiles, so that profile has to be created (owner types any key). Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts run <CC lane> -- scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v30-hf-fold.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator", twice.

requires.why: the M05 hole is in ST's Chat Completion assembly (setOpenAIMessages), so the main API must be Chat Completion and connected; seals are mocked so the judge stays off; the inner beat would make a model call inside the one Generate

const state = globalThis.__hfFold; const records = (globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().memory.chapters ?? []).filter((entry) => entry.status === 'sealed'); const first = records.find((entry) => entry.chapterId === 'ch1'); const second = records.find((entry) => entry.chapterId === 'ch2'); const keepTail = 2; const problems = []; const seen = state.seen; if (!seen || seen.calls !== 1 || !seen.rows) throw new Error('the generate interceptor did not run exactly once on a real Generate: ' + JSON.stringify({ calls: seen?.calls, error: state.error })); if (state.promptShape !== 'messages' || !state.prompt) throw new Error('GENERATE_AFTER_DATA gave no CC messages array (' + state.promptShape + '): either the main API is not Chat Completion or ST threw while building the prompt (a hole reaches populateChatHistory as undefined, openai.js:948); error: ' + state.error); const marker = (text) => { const found = /\[hf-r(\d+)\]/.exec(text); return found ? Number(found[1]) : null; }; const rows = seen.rows.map((row, position) => ({ position, ignored: row.ignored, id: marker(row.mes) })); const folded = rows.filter((row) => row.ignored); const kept = rows.filter((row) => !row.ignored); const firstKept = rows.findIndex((row) => !row.ignored); const holes = firstKept < 0 ? [] : rows.slice(firstKept).filter((row) => row.ignored).map((row) => row.position); if (!folded.length) problems.push('nothing folded: two sealed chapters with fold on folded no row'); if (holes.length) problems.push('ignored rows after the first kept row (the M05 hole): positions ' + JSON.stringify(holes)); const expected = []; for (let id = first.range.from; id <= second.range.to - keepTail; id += 1) expected.push(id); const foldedIds = folded.map((row) => row.id); if (JSON.stringify(foldedIds) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) problems.push('folded rows are not one block from record 1 through record 2 minus keep_tail: folded ' + JSON.stringify(foldedIds) + ', expected ' + JSON.stringify(expected)); const tail = []; for (let id = second.range.to - keepTail + 1; id <= state.lastRow; id += 1) tail.push(id); const keptIds = kept.map((row) => row.id).filter((id) => id !== null); if (JSON.stringify(keptIds) !== JSON.stringify(tail)) problems.push('kept rows are not the tail: kept ' + JSON.stringify(keptIds) + ', expected ' + JSON.stringify(tail)); const bad = state.prompt.filter((message) => message.hole || typeof message.content !== 'string').length; if (bad) problems.push(bad + ' CC message(s) without string content (a hole)'); const inPrompt = state.prompt.flatMap((message) => [...String(message.content ?? '').matchAll(/\[hf-r(\d+)\]/g)].map((found) => Number(found[1]))); const leaked = inPrompt.filter((id) => expected.includes(id)); if (leaked.length) problems.push('folded rows reached the CC prompt: ' + JSON.stringify(leaked)); const ordered = inPrompt.filter((id) => tail.includes(id)); if (JSON.stringify(ordered) !== JSON.stringify(tail)) problems.push('the CC prompt does not hold every kept row once and in order: ' + JSON.stringify(ordered) + ' vs ' + JSON.stringify(tail)); const out = { records: records.map((entry) => ({ chapter: entry.chapterId, range: entry.range })), keepTail, interceptorRows: rows.length, folded: { count: folded.length, from: foldedIds[0] ?? null, to: foldedIds[foldedIds.length - 1] ?? null }, kept: keptIds, holes, ccMessages: state.prompt.length, ccRoles: state.prompt.map((message) => message.role).join(','), markersInPrompt: inPrompt, generateError: state.error }; if (problems.length) throw new Error(problems.join('; ') + ' :: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); return out;
